name: Panel from Model Cooking Stove:  Raven Flanked by Snake-Entwined Tortoises
aliases: 陶炉上的  龜蛇烏鴉浮雕
summary: Han dynasty tombs were often furnished with grave goods to provide the deceased with items for the afterlife. Four earthenware panels were made in molds and then joined together to make a miniature model of a stove, which was placed in a burial chamber. The four sides show the animals of the cardina
